scope: Exact plant ingredient identities wrongly linked to milk by the importer. Preference aliases only: does not change stock, recipe ingredient records, quantities or overall dietary labels. Not an allergy certification.

evidence.decision: Publisher explicitly uses vegan butter, soya milk and vegan cheddar.
Publisher uses soy milk for vegan scones.
Publisher specifies fortified soya yoghurt and almond butter in a vegan breakfast.
Coconut milk is distinct from dairy milk; retain its exact stock identity.
Manufacturer describes peanut powder; do not infer dairy from the word butter.
Milk and cream are listed. Retain the milk alias for ex-coconut-yogurt-8276bb66, named by the dhansak publisher. Do not apply a coconut-name rule.

basis: The remaining names explicitly identify almond/coconut/soy milk or cream, nut butter, or nondairy products. Reviewed IDs are enumerated, not a runtime substring rule. Recipes with other dairy ingredients still fail the milk exclusion.
